purpose: Review official Italian/Sicilian cadastral channels and qualify bounded anonymous parcel geometry evidence for Catania.
assessment: The official Regione Siciliana SITR Cartografia Catastale ArcGIS service was identified and queried anonymously. Its Particelle layer returned multiple Catania polygon features in a bounded WGS84 envelope around the unchanged WUP point. This is local public geometry evidence, not a citywide completeness claim.
registryAssessment: A regional cadastral map custodian is evidenced: Regione Siciliana SITR publishes the regional Cartografia Catastale service. The Comune di Catania SIT viewer was also found, but its Catasto_Georef_Sit description says the data are non-probative georeferencing; it was not used as the retained geometry source.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official service metadata, Particelle schema inspection, and one bounded anonymous bbox request around the immutable WUP point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Multiple safe Catania parcel polygons, with C351/087015 identifiers and parcel components, were returned.

officialPrimarySources.scope: Official regional Cartografia Catastale MapServer; service description says it covers the entire Sicilian territory.

Municipal SIT viewer; Catasto_Georef_Sit is described as non-probative georeferenced data.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: A bounded envelope containing the unchanged WUP point returned Catania Particelle polygons; this is not an absence or completeness test.

nextStep: Root/serial review should independently qualify the public route, CRS/order, composite identity stability, rate limits, and bounded coverage before any adapter admission. Keep runtime held until then.
remainingUncertainty: One local bbox query cannot establish citywide completeness or freshness; the municipal viewer's non-probative caveat remains relevant; service behavior outside the tested extent was not assessed.
